sources.method: Entry-level search locator used for orientation only; specific statements are checked against the higher-tier reference and official records where available.

statement.zh: **攻击**：肖尔算法（Shor's Algorithm）。NIST IR 8547 对肖尔算法的作用对象给出明确结论。§2.1.1 在列出 ECDSA、RSA（RFC 8017）与 EdDSA（RFC 8032）以及 SP 800-186 指定的曲线之后写道：「These algorithms are vulnerable to Shor's Algorithm on a cryptanalytically relevant quantum computer.」§2.1.2 对 SP 800-56A（有限域与椭圆曲线离散对数，含 Diffie-Hellman 与 MQV 变体）与 SP 800-56B（基于 RSA 的密钥建立）给出同一判断：「The key-establishment algorithms in both of these Special Publications are vulnerable to Shor's Algorithm on a cryptanalytically relevant quantum computer.」。
statement.en: **Attack**: Shor's Algorithm (肖尔算法).NIST IR 8547 is explicit about what Shor's algorithm threatens.

statement.zh: FIPS 186-5 在 §1 给出同一立场的标准文本：「Note that the algorithms in this standard are not expected to provide resistance to attacks from a large-scale quantum computer.Digital signature algorithms that will provide security from quantum computers will be specified in future NIST publications.」这正是把 RSA、ECDSA 与 EdDSA 归入量子脆弱一类并需要更换的原因陈述。
statement.en: FIPS 186-5 states the same position in §1: "Note that the algorithms in this standard are not expected to provide resistance to attacks from a large-scale quantum computer.Digital signature algorithms that will provide security from quantum computers will be specified in future NIST publications." That is the standards text explaining why RSA, ECDSA and EdDSA are classed as quantum-vulnerable and must be replaced.

statement.zh: 该算法覆盖的范围可从标准自身的分类读出：FIPS 186-5 附录 A 引言说明「Discrete logarithm cryptography (DLC) is divided into finite field cryptography (FFC) and elliptic curve cryptography (ECC).… DSA is an example of FFC, and ECDSA is an example of ECC.Other examples of DLC are the Diffie-Hellman and MQV key agreement algorithms」，并说明「The most common example of integer factorization cryptography (IFC) is RSA.」IR 8547 在算法清单段落与末尾总结两处都把离散对数与整数分解两类写成在够用的量子机上会被肖尔算法攻破，覆盖的正是上面这两类。
statement.en: The reach of the algorithm follows from the standard's own taxonomy.The Appendix A introduction of FIPS 186-5 says "Discrete logarithm cryptography (DLC) is divided into finite field cryptography (FFC) and elliptic curve cryptography (ECC).

statement.zh: IR 8547 只给结论、不给复杂度：全文“Shor”仅出现两次（§2.1.1 与 §2.1.2），未给出多项式时间或量子比特数的表述，该条目目也不超出该范围。
statement.en: IR 8547 gives conclusions, not complexity: “Shor” appears only twice, in §2.1.1 and §2.1.2, with no polynomial-time or qubit-count statement, and this entry goes no further.The mitigation path is in the same document: §4 states that "NIST will deprecate quantum-vulnerable public-key cryptography after 2030 and disallow its use under NIST standards and guidelines after 2035", while the §1 introduction cites the "harvest now, decrypt later" threat — collecting ciphertext now and decrypting once such a machine exists — as the reason to act immediately.

statement.zh:
标准文本的时间线是：FIPS 186-5（2023 年 2 月）承认本标准的算法不预期抵抗大规模量子计算机，并说量子安全签名将由后续 NIST 出版物规定；NIST IR 8547（2026 年 10 月）把这一判断具体到算法清单与迁移日期，明确两类公钥机（§2.1.1 签名、§2.1.2 密钥建立）都可被肖尔算法攻破。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(T=\mathrm{poly}(\log N)\)。输入：输入：肖尔算法的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：N 待分解整数；Shor 算法在量子计算机上多项式时间分解。
statement.en: The standards timeline is: FIPS 186-5 (February 2023) concedes that its algorithms are not expected to resist a large-scale quantum computer and says quantum-safe signatures will come in future publications; NIST IR 8547 (October 2026) makes that concrete, naming both public-key families — signatures in §2.1.1 and key establishment in §2.1.2 — as vulnerable to Shor's algorithm and attaching migration dates in §4.
